name: ch.hslu.blebooking.ArchitectureIT
comment: Checks the layer rules inside a module: controller, service, repository. The rules also pass while a layer is still empty, so they are already active for the first feature.

name: ch.hslu.blebooking.ModularityIT
comment: Checks that the modules only use the dependencies declared in their package-info.java and that there are no cycles between modules.

methods.name: writesModuleDocumentation
methods.comment: Writes module diagrams (PlantUML) to target/spring-modulith-docs, so they can be compared with the architecture diagram in the report.

name: ch.hslu.blebooking.common.TestEndpoints
comment: Endpoints that only exist in tests, because the backend has no real endpoints yet. Only loaded by tests that import this class.

name: ch.hslu.blebooking.common.TestJwt
comment: Creates access tokens for tests, signed like the real ones (HS256).

name: ch.hslu.blebooking.common.error.ErrorHandlingIT
comment: Checks that errors are returned as Problem Details (RFC 9457) with a "code" field and without internal details.

name: ch.hslu.blebooking.common.security.SecurityIT
comment: Checks the security baseline: access token required, /auth/** open, roles from the token.
